items.institutional_statement: Tipo de Hueso: Hueso Plano Alargado.
items.anatomical_application: Classifies the clavicle as a flat elongated bone due to its cortical plates and absence of a medullary canal, consistent with Testut and Latarjet teaching traditions.

items.institutional_statement: Extremo Medial: Esternal / Esferoide (manubrio del esternón y 1º cartílago costal).
items.anatomical_application: Directly guides students to identify the bulbous, spheroid/quadrangular medial extremity articulating with the sternum and 1st costal cartilage.

items.institutional_statement: Extremo Lateral: Acromial / Plano (con el acromion de la escápula).
items.anatomical_application: Directly contrasts the flattened plate-like lateral end with the bulbous medial end to determine mediolateral orientation.

items.institutional_statement: Posee 2 Caras: Superior e Inferior. Posee 2 Bordes: Anterior y Posterior.
items.anatomical_application: Establishes the fundamental 4-surface/border framework for systematic cadaveric inspection.

items.institutional_statement: 1/3 Lateral: Inserción descendente del músculo trapecio en cara superior - borde posterior.
items.anatomical_application: Identifies the posterior rough zone of the lateral third as the key landmark for trapezius insertion.

items.institutional_statement: 1/3 Lateral: Inserción del músculo deltoides en cara superior - borde anterior.
items.anatomical_application: Identifies the anterior border of the lateral third as the origin of clavicular fibers of the deltoid.

items.institutional_statement: 2/3 Mediales: Inserción del músculo pectoral mayor en cara superior - borde anterior.
items.anatomical_application: Maps the robust muscular ridge on the medial two-thirds anterior border to pectoralis major origin.

items.institutional_statement: Surco Deltopectoral: Vena Cefálica y Rama Deltoidea.
items.anatomical_application: Highlights the deltopectoral groove as the cardinal superficial surgical reference harboring the cephalic vein and deltoid artery.

items.institutional_statement: Impresión del ligamento costoclavicular en cara inferior del 1/3 medial.
items.anatomical_application: Designates the medial oval rugosity as the inferior anchor of the costoclavicular ligament.

items.institutional_statement: Surco del músculo subclavio en 1/3 medio cara inferior.
items.anatomical_application: Uses the longitudinal groove of the middle third to confirm the inferior aspect of the clavicular shaft.

items.institutional_statement: Tubérculo conoideo y línea trapezoidea en 1/3 lateral cara inferior.
items.anatomical_application: Directs palpation to the conoid tubercle and trapezoid line on the lateral inferior aspect for coracoclavicular ligament identification.

items.institutional_statement: Presenta Acromion como continuación lateral de la espina; punto palpable superior del hombro.
items.anatomical_application: Establishes the acromion as the palpable lateral benchmark for tracing the acromioclavicular joint line.

items.institutional_statement: Presenta Apófisis Coracoides en el ángulo lateral; anclaje ligamentario coracoclavicular.
items.anatomical_application: Establishes the coracoid process in the infraclavicular fossa as the inferior landmark for palpating the tension of the coracoclavicular ligaments.
